description: This file defines the UpgradeMetaHelper class, which manages tasks related to upgrade modules in SuiteCRM, including loading modules, detecting modifications, parsing metadata files, and creating upgrade directories.

classes.name: UpgradeMetaHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing functionalities for managing module upgrades, including detection of modified and customized modules, parsing metadata, and directory management.

methods.name: getModifiedModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules with files that differ from their stored md5 checksums, indicating modifications.

methods.name: saveMatchingFilesQueries
methods.description: Saves a list of matching files for a given upgrade step into a PHP file in the cache directory.

methods.name: getAllCustomizedModulesBeyondStudio
methods.description: Returns modules that have been customized beyond studio modifications by comparing file md5s.

methods.name: getAllCustomizedModules
methods.description: Analyzes modules for customized files by comparing current md5s with base md5s and detects modifications or new files.

methods.name: loadStudioModules
methods.description: Returns an array of module names that have a 'studio.php' file in their metadata directory, indicating studio-enabled modules.

methods.name: runParser
methods.description: Creates parser instances for editing and detail views and runs parsing over upgrade modules.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses specific module files like EditView, DetailView, or SearchForm for modification and prepares them for upgrade.

methods.name: create_upgrade_directory
methods.description: Creates the necessary directory structure for the upgrade process with module metadata and copies relevant files.

methods.name: verifyMetaData
methods.description: Checks if a metadata file contains valid structure, especially panels array or search definitions, for a given module and view.
